spec.description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Spacer Biscuits are made of expanded black polyethylene material and are used to achieve and maintain adequate reflective air spaces between reflective insulation and the adjacent material[]. The biscuits are slit to allow easy placement over wall ties and provide strong holding power with no long-term deterioration[]. Adhesive backed for ease of use on foil faces, they can be re-positioned to allow alignment with the substrate[].

install: In cavity brick walls, lay outer leaf of brickwork with wire wall ties in place [1.1.9]
Clip Spacer Biscuit onto wire tie and push firmly against the brickwork[
Install approximately one biscuit per square metre or onto every second tie to maintain a nominal 20mm air space[][
Roll out AIR-CELL horizontally with anti-glare facing the installer and offer up to wall[][
Cut a slit in the AIR-CELL for each wire tie to protrude through using a sharp knife[
Push AIR-CELL over ties until firmly against the Spacer Biscuit[
In framed walls, peel adhesive backing and stick Spacer Biscuits to outside of AIR-CELL between framework[
Fix external cladding through the AIR-CELL to the frame ensuring maintained airspace[

retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Spacer Biscuits are 60 x 60 x 20 mm expanded black polyethylene spacers designed to create and preserve a nominal 20mm reflective airspace between Kingspan AIR-CELL reflective insulation and adjacent wall substrates. Slit for rapid placement over standard wire wall ties and featuring an adhesive backing for repositionable installation against foil facings, they guarantee the reflective air cavity necessary to achieve rated system R-values. They are fibre-free, inert, and non-deteriorating, making them essential for cavity brick, brick veneer, and framed wall installations.
